t.why: A shipping power with the world's largest merchant fleet. It has maritime boundary disputes with Turkey.
t.rel: It has a long-running dispute with Turkey over Aegean islands and sea boundaries. Because northern Greece also has a region called Macedonia, Greece objected for nearly 30 years to its neighbor using the same name and blocked its entry into NATO and the EU. The dispute ended when the neighbor renamed itself North Macedonia in 2019, and North Macedonia joined NATO the following year.
t.korea: It fought in the Korean War, and Greek owners have ordered many ships from Korean shipyards.
t.know: Its national anthem comes from a 158-verse poem, making its lyrics the longest of any anthem.
t.etext: A shipping power: Greek owners control a large share of the world's merchant fleet. Tourism and farm products such as olive oil matter too. After a debt crisis in the 2010s, it has recovered while paying down debt.
